cells.gaps: No source gives a count of pilot establishments or says whether they are primary or secondary, and none reports FIUE-BF or the national pupil file past its pilot: at 25 June 2025 enrolment had not begun and at 14 April 2025 the student management platform was still to be designed. The sources disagree on how the record is kept (BFA-017 pilot establishments online in 2023, BFA-009 mainly hard copies in April 2025) and BFA-017 does not say results are entered during the year; finance was the general budget in February 2024 (BFA-014) and donor only in the newer rows; no current plan naming the system and no dated event in the twelve months are held.
cells.note: A learner register (FIUE-BF) was at its pilot phase in February 2024 and its successors were still being prepared in 2025, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs live use or a register filled past its pilot, and no row reports either.
